conflict: That conflicts with an existing record.
couldNotCopy: Couldn't copy — please select and copy manually.
forbidden: You don't have access to this.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
rateLimitedWithSeconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
rootError: This page didn't load. Try again, or reload.
serverError: Something didn't work on our end. Try again in a moment.
sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

reasons.PACKAGE_EXISTS: You already have a package with that name.
reasons.PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND: That package wasn’t found. It may have been deleted.
reasons.INVALID_PACKAGE_NAME: That isn’t a valid package name for this ecosystem.
reasons.GIT_URL_REQUIRED: Add a git URL before approving.
reasons.SSH_KEY_REQUIRED: SSH git URLs need an SSH key. Choose one.
reasons.SSH_KEY_NOT_FOUND: That SSH key wasn’t found. Choose another one.
reasons.SSH_KEY_UNREADABLE: That SSH key can no longer be read. Replace it in Access → SSH keys.
reasons.ENCRYPTION_UNAVAILABLE: This server isn’t set up to store SSH keys. Ask the admin.
reasons.INVALID_REMOTE_URL: That git URL isn’t supported. Use https:// or an SSH URL.
reasons.PRIVATE_ADDRESS: That host points at a private or local address, which Cockpit Context won’t reach.
reasons.HOST_UNRESOLVABLE: That host name couldn’t be found. Check the URL.
reasons.HOST_KEY_UNCONFIRMED: Confirm this git host’s SSH key first.
reasons.INVALID_REF: That isn’t a valid tag, branch or commit name.
reasons.REF_NOT_FOUND: No tag, branch or commit matched that ref.
reasons.CHECKOUT_NOT_FOUND: That checkout wasn’t found. It may have been removed.
reasons.CHECKOUT_LEASED: A running question is reading this checkout. Try again when it finishes.
reasons.GIT_FAILED: The git server refused or failed the request.
reasons.GIT_TIMEOUT: The git server took too long to answer. Try again.
reasons.MODEL_NOT_CONFIGURED: No model is set up on this server. Ask the admin.
reasons.ENGINE_STOPPED: The server is restarting. Try again in a moment.
reasons.CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND: That conversation wasn’t found. It may have been deleted.
reasons.RUN_FINISHED: The agent has already finished. Ask a follow-up instead.
reasons.RUN_ACTIVE: An investigation is still running here. Stop it first, or wait for it to finish.
reasons.BUSY: You already have the most questions waiting for an investigation slot. Wait for some to finish, then ask again.
reasons.EXPIRY_IN_PAST: Choose an expiry in the future.
reasons.EXPIRY_TOO_FAR: Tokens can last at most a year.
reasons.TOKEN_LIMIT: You have the most active tokens allowed. Revoke one first.
reasons.CREATE_CONFLICT: Another token was being created at the same time. Try again.
reasons.TOKEN_CHANGED: This token changed while you were editing it. Reload and try again.
reasons.CONNECTION_CHANGED: This connection changed while you were editing it. Reload and try again.
reasons.TOKEN_REVOKED: That token was revoked, so it can’t be changed.
reasons.CONNECTION_REVOKED: That connection was revoked, so it can’t be changed.
reasons.SSH_KEY_IN_USE: A package still uses this key. Switch it to another key first.
reasons.SSH_KEY_INVALID: That private key couldn’t be read. Paste the whole file.
reasons.SSH_KEY_PASSPHRASE_REQUIRED: That key is protected by a passphrase. Enter it too.
reasons.SSH_KEY_PASSPHRASE_INVALID: That passphrase doesn’t open the key.
reasons.SSH_KEY_PASSPHRASE_TOO_LONG: Passphrases longer than 1023 bytes are not supported.
reasons.SSH_KEY_PASSPHRASE_LINE_BREAK: Passphrases with line breaks are not supported.
reasons.SSH_KEY_UNSUPPORTED: That key type isn’t supported. Use Ed25519, ECDSA or RSA.
reasons.SSH_KEY_DUPLICATE: You already have this SSH key.
reasons.INVALID_HOST: That host or port isn’t valid.
reasons.HOST_SCAN_FAILED: That host didn’t offer any SSH host keys. Check the host and port.
reasons.KNOWN_HOST_NOT_FOUND: That host key wasn’t found. It may have been removed.
reasons.JOB_NOT_FAILED: Only failed jobs can be retried. This one has already moved on.
reasons.PACKAGE_SNAPSHOT_REF_MISSING: This version is not in the snapshot. Update it with your SSH key in Cockpit Context, then try again.
reasons.PASSWORD_LINK_ADMIN_TARGET: An administrator can't receive a password link. Demote the account to a user first.
reasons.PASSWORD_LINK_DELIVERY_FAILED: The password link email couldn't be sent, so no link was issued. Check the mail settings and try again.

pageNotFound.title: Page not found
pageNotFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or is no longer available.
